subject: english
question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

A situation when no progress is possible
solution: The correct answer is '**Deadlock**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Deadlock**'. • It means** 'a situation in which two sides cannot reach an agreement'.** (ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें दोनों पक्ष समझौते पर न पहुँच सकें; गतिरोध) • *Example: Talks have reached a **deadlock**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Deadlock.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Deadline**: a time or date before which something must be done or finished. (किसी कार्य का पूरा करने के लिए निर्धारित अंतिम तिथि, सीमा रेखा) • **Acceptance**: the act of accepting or being accepted. (स्‍वीकार करने या स्‍वीकार्य होने की क्रिया) • **Harmony**: a state of agreement or of peaceful existence together. (सामंजस्‍य, तालमेल) 41:Ta11, The correct answer is** 'a lot'.**
